title: The Farmer Who Watered Dirt for 5 Years
description: A short story about patience, and why the roots grow before anything shows.
character: a stickman farmer with a big round white head, messy spiky black hair, a worn straw hat, a brown vest and simple rolled-up trousers

scenes.caption: He planted one tiny seed
scenes.narration: Once there was a farmer who planted a single bamboo seed, and promised to water it every day.
scenes.image: the farmer kneeling in a sunny green field at golden hour, gently pressing a tiny seed into the soil with a hopeful smile, watering can beside him

scenes.caption: Year one. Nothing.
scenes.narration: Year one. Nothing happened. Not a single leaf.
scenes.image: extreme close-up of the farmer's face, eyes wide and confused, staring down at bare brown soil, a small watering can in his hand, soft morning light

scenes.caption: Year two. Still nothing.
scenes.narration: Year two. Still nothing. The neighbours started to laugh.
scenes.image: the farmer standing over a patch of bare dirt in rain with his watering can, shoulders slumped, while a second stickman neighbour in the background points and laughs at him

scenes.caption: You are wasting your time
scenes.narration: You're wasting your time, they said. That seed is dead.
scenes.image: two stickmen face to face in a village lane at sunset, the neighbour smirking with arms crossed on the right, the farmer on the left looking hurt and doubtful, dramatic warm light

scenes.caption: Years three and four
scenes.narration: Years three and four. Rain, heat, and wind. And still, he kept watering.
scenes.image: the farmer standing alone in a stormy field at dusk carrying a watering can toward a patch of bare soil, wind blowing his hat, dramatic dark clouds and golden light on the horizon

scenes.caption: But underground...
scenes.narration: But underground, something was happening that no one could see.
scenes.image: cutaway view of dark soil showing thick white bamboo roots spreading wide underground like glowing veins, tiny sparkles of light, mysterious blue and amber tones, no character visible

scenes.caption: Year five
scenes.narration: Then in year five, the shoot broke through the ground.
scenes.image: close-up of the farmer's shocked face, mouth wide open, eyebrows raised high, with a bright green bamboo shoot bursting out of the soil beside him, dawn light

scenes.caption: Ninety feet in six weeks
scenes.narration: In just six weeks, it shot up ninety feet into the sky.
scenes.image: a gigantic bamboo forest towering into a glowing sunrise sky, the tiny farmer in the lower foreground arms thrown up in joy, the neighbour next to him with his jaw dropped in disbelief

scenes.caption: It was growing roots
scenes.narration: It wasn't growing slowly. It was building roots. And roots are what let you rise.
scenes.image: the farmer sitting calmly beneath a huge bamboo tree smiling warmly with eyes closed, golden sunlight rays through green leaves, peaceful mood

scenes.caption: Keep watering your dreams
scenes.narration: So if nothing seems to be happening in your life right now, keep watering. Your roots are growing.
scenes.image: the farmer looking straight at the viewer with a warm confident smile, watering can in hand, towering bamboo forest behind him at golden hour
